real(c_float) :: c1, c2
real(c_float), allocatable, dimension(:) :: a, b, c
integer :: i
real(c_double) :: x, y

allocate(a(20), b(20), c(20))

a = 42.0
b = 43.0
c = 0.0

call simple()
call easy(2, 4)
call no_problem(2.0, 4.0, c1)

print*, c1

call no_problemas(2.0, 4.0, c2)

print*, c2

call many_numbers(a, b, c, 20)

do i=1,20
    print*, c(i)
end do

print*, myfunc(1.0_c_double)
makes three arrays of length 20. The assignments fill them before

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)

if (APPLE)
        set(CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER "/usr/local/bin/gfortran")
endif()

project(fortran_cpp LANGUAGES CXX Fortran)

set(CMAKE_INCLUDE_CURRENT_DIR ON)

file(GLOB fortran_files *.f90)
file(GLOB cpp_files *.h *.cpp)

add_executable(fortran_cpp ${fortran_files} ${cpp_files})
is the version the list was written for. CMake 3.31 on this machine still configures it.
